title: About TikSaveMP4
description: Learn how TikSaveMP4 saves public TikTok videos and photo slideshows, which formats are available, and what source quality and access limits mean.
sections: What we do

TikSaveMP4 checks public TikTok post links and prepares available videos or photo slideshows for download. Save a video as MP4, save an individual image, or package photo slides in their original order as a ZIP.
What to expect

Available quality depends on the source. Some posts are blocked by TikTok, unavailable in your region, private, deleted or limited to signed-in users. We do not ask for TikTok passwords or login cookies.
Independent service
TikSaveMP4 is not affiliated with TikTok or ByteDance. Downloading does not grant permission to republish someone elseâ€™s work. Respect copyright and keep creator attribution.

title: Contact TikSaveMP4
description: Get help with TikTok video, image, or ZIP downloads. Find out which link, device details, and error message to include when contacting TikSaveMP4.
sections: Download help

Include the public TikTok post link, your browser and device, and the exact error message. Say whether the error happened while checking the link, preparing the file, or saving it. Never send passwords or login cookies.
Access limits
Check that the link is a public video or photo post. Private, deleted and region-restricted posts may be unavailable. Repeated requests cannot remove these restrictions.

title: Privacy policy
description: Read how TikSaveMP4 processes TikTok links, temporary download files, operational records, and optional analytics, plus your privacy choices.
sections: Links and temporary files

Submitted public TikTok links are sent to the server for validation, extraction and file preparation. Download jobs and media files are temporary and expire after the configured retention period, which defaults to 15 minutes. We do not need your TikTok password.
Operational records

The server uses request information for rate limiting and may record download outcomes, error categories, timestamps and operational logs. Hosting infrastructure may log IP addresses. Administrator sessions use essential cookies.
Third-party connections

The server contacts TikTok and its media delivery networks. Preview images load directly from those networks, which can receive your IP address. Optional Google Analytics measures public page visits and download events using cookies. It does not receive submitted media links or download job identifiers. Collection follows regional policy and your analytics choice; unknown regions require consent. Browser Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals are respected.
Your choices

Do not submit private information. Use the contact page to ask about privacy or deletion. Use Analytics settings at the bottom of any page to allow or decline optional analytics, or use the opt-out link below.

title: Terms of use
description: Read the terms for using TikSaveMP4, including permitted downloads, copyright responsibilities, temporary files, service limits, and source availability.
sections: Permitted use

Use the service to save content you own or have permission to download. Respect creators, copyright, privacy and applicable platform terms. Do not use this service to bypass private-account access controls.
Availability and quality
The service depends on publicly accessible source media. Access and formats may change without notice. No guarantee is made about availability, watermark removal or source quality.
Fair use of the service
Do not abuse the service through excessive automation, harmful links or attempts to defeat rate limits. Temporary download links expire; keep your own copies of authorized originals.

title: Copyright
description: Learn about creator rights when saving TikTok content, permitted reuse, and the information to provide when reporting a copyright concern to TikSaveMP4.
sections: Creator rights
Rights to downloaded content remain with the original rights holders. TikSaveMP4 is an independent tool and does not grant a licence to reuse or republish a work.
Report a concern
Send the public post URL, a description of the original work, your relationship to the rights holder and a contact method. Avoid sending unnecessary personal documents in an initial request.

title: Responsible Use
description: Respect creators, permissions and public-access limits when saving TikTok videos with TikSaveMp4.
sections: Use TikSaveMP4 responsibly
A video being public does not mean every use of it is permitted. Use TikSaveMP4 to save content responsibly and respect the people who made or appear in it.
Before downloading

Confirm you own the video or have permission for your intended use. Permission to watch or save a personal copy does not necessarily permit reposting, advertising, resale or other distribution. Music and other material within a video can have separate rights. Only supported, publicly accessible TikTok links can be processed. Private, restricted, login-only and permission-controlled content is not supported. Use only an HTTPS public TikTok link from the approved TikTok hosts. Do not send credentials, account details or private or sensitive material. Do not attempt to bypass technical access restrictions.
After downloading

Keep creator attribution and any license information. Do not misrepresent authorship, impersonate a creator, harass people shown in a video or use content to violate privacy. Seek separate permission before reuse where required. Delete copies if you discover you lack the necessary permission. Downloading does not transfer copyright, privacy rights or any other rights to you. Respect creators, applicable law and platform rules; do not use downloaded content to exploit others or deceive viewers. Extracting or downloading audio does not grant ownership, redistribution rights or commercial-use permission. Music, recordings and performances may have separate rights holders. Obtain the permissions required for your intended use; MP3 conversion does not make music copyright-free or royalty-free.
Respect service limits

Choose only a format offered for your analyzed video. Do not automate bulk scraping or work around rate, concurrency, duration or size limits. Unknown sizes and progress are shown as unknown; available source quality is never enhanced by this service. Available formats and quality depend on the source. TikSaveMP4 does not improve, upscale or restore source quality. Watermark behavior depends on the media source supplied by TikTok. The service does not crop, blur, paint over or artificially remove ownership marks; do not remove ownership information to misrepresent authorship.
Responsible and inappropriate examples

Responsible uses include saving your own published video, saving a video with the creatorâ€™s permission, or keeping a copy where applicable law permits that use. Check that any permission also covers the soundtrack and your intended later use. Inappropriate or prohibited uses include republishing another creatorâ€™s work without permission, selling content without rights, attempting to access private videos, removing attribution to pretend you created a video, or using content for harassment, exploitation or deception. This guidance is general information, not personalized legal advice.
Report a concern

See the Copyright page for what to include in a rights complaint and the Contact page for the current reporting channel. TikSaveMP4 does not host a public library of submitted videos and cannot remove the original video from TikTok or recall copies already saved to another personâ€™s device.
